summary: Adaptive INTENT is the default z-harness paradigm (workflow.planning_mode=intent, default). Replaces thick up-front SPEC/PLAN/TASKS with: (1) thin frozen INTENT.md contract authored at /z-plan time and immutable after frozen_at is stamped; (2) emergent BFS task-tree generated one level at a time by agents/task-tree-generator.md (Sonnet) — Level 0 from INTENT, Level N+1 from Level N outcomes + unmet acceptance criteria; (3) append-only LEDGER.md accumulating decisions+deviations as the realized-plan audit trail read by /z-review-all. Level depth (L1 quick / L2 standard / L3 deep) is chosen by agents/intent-classifier.md (Haiku, advisory), announced to user with inline override, or forced via workflow.intent_level. /z-implement-all mode-detection seam (commands/z-implement-all.md:413): SPEC.md present → legacy unchanged; INTENT.md present → INTENT engine. Freeze: scripts/intent-schema.py freeze-intent (line 439) stamps frozen_at ISO, snapshots to archive/$RUN/INTENT.frozen.md; bootstrap-ledger (line 494) creates LEDGER.md idempotently. BFS loop: generate level (task-tree-generator dispatch) → execute level (existing per-task loop) → checkpoint (evaluate-acceptance; scripts/intent-schema.py:635). Loop exits when all acceptance criteria met or level cap (default 6, workflow.intent_bfs_level_cap) or budget guard (30k tokens) hit. Implementer returns LEDGER_DECISIONS+LEDGER_DEVIATIONS (agents/implementer.md:135); reviewer reads full INTENT narrative + LEDGER + durable tier, cites 'fails acceptance criterion #N' (agents/reviewer.md:74–102). /z-amend: reopen-intent sets frozen_at:pending (scripts/intent-schema.py:377); marks TASKS.md stale_reason:amended-intent for regeneration on next run. /z-do → /z-plan --quick shim; /z-plan-light → /z-plan --standard shim. Hermes gated OFF by default (workflow.hermes_enabled=false, Invariant 6); all old machinery no-ops unless explicitly enabled. Four new workflow.* knobs (config.py:78–81): planning_mode, intent_level, intent_parallel_levels (default false), hermes_enabled (default false). No new env vars (Invariant 5).

entry_points.summary: Validates INTENT.md frontmatter (required fields: artifact/slug/level/generated_at/frozen_at/planning_mode) and required sections per level (acceptance checklist always; not-doing+consider-for-this at L2+). Returns ValidationResult(ok, errors).
Lints acceptance checklist items for non-observable criteria (bare 'runs'/'works' with no concrete object). Returns list[LintFailure] with 1-based line numbers.
Stamps frozen_at with current ISO timestamp in INTENT.md frontmatter. Idempotent: if already frozen, prints ALREADY_FROZEN:<iso>. Prints FROZEN:<iso> on new freeze. Called by /z-implement-all Step 1.
Sets frozen_at back to 'pending' in INTENT.md frontmatter. Idempotent (prints ALREADY_PENDING if already pending). Called by /z-amend Phase 6 to re-open a frozen contract for amendment.
Creates LEDGER.md with frontmatter (artifact, slug, intent_frozen_at) if absent. Idempotent: prints ALREADY_EXISTS if file already present. Called by /z-implement-all Step 1.

Evaluates which acceptance checklist items in INTENT.md are met, given LEDGER.md decisions and optionally the cumulative diff. Returns AcceptanceResult(verdict='done'|'incomplete', unmet_criteria, met_criteria). Called at every BFS level checkpoint.

Authoritative SPEC-vs-INTENT branch: if $BASE/SPEC.md exists → IMPLEMENT_MODE=legacy (untouched); elif $BASE/INTENT.md exists → IMPLEMENT_MODE=intent. Neither → error. This is the ONLY detection seam (Invariant 4).

Step 1 of INTENT engine: freeze INTENT.md (idempotent), snapshot to archive/$RUN/INTENT.frozen.md on first freeze, bootstrap LEDGER.md if absent. Wired at /z-implement-all inside if [[ IMPLEMENT_MODE == intent ]] block.

BFS loop: while BFS_DONE=0 and BFS_HALTED=0: check level cap + budget → dispatch task-tree-generator → execute level tasks → checkpoint (evaluate-acceptance) → increment CURRENT_LEVEL or set BFS_DONE=1.

Reads workflow.planning_mode and workflow.intent_level. planning_mode=full → legacy SDD path. planning_mode=intent → dispatch intent-classifier (or use forced level), announce level with user override gate, write INTENT.md.
Invariant 4 guard in /z-plan: if slug dir already has SPEC.md, treat as legacy and route to the legacy amend/implement path; never overwrite a legacy plan with INTENT.md.

Haiku subagent. Input: raw task prompt + repo signals + optional forced_level. Output: LEVEL: quick|standard|deep + REASON: + SIGNALS:. Advisory — orchestrator announces pick, user may override. Sibling to complexity-classifier.

Sonnet subagent. Input: frozen INTENT snapshot, LEDGER, level number, unmet_criteria JSON, prior_level_outcomes, tasks_output_path, level_cap. Output: writes TASKS.md batch for this level only — all siblings independent (no intra-level deps), each with **Advances:** criterion #N. Cross-level deps deferred to next level.

invariants: INV-1: INTENT.md is immutable after frozen_at is stamped. Edits require explicit reopen-intent (scripts/intent-schema.py:377).
INV-2: A level's TASKS.md is immutable while that level executes. done_set_hash checkpoint at level boundary (commands/z-implement-all.md:903).
INV-3: LEDGER.md is append-only; never rewritten (scripts/intent-schema.py:494 bootstrap is idempotent; only append thereafter).

INV-4: Legacy SPEC/PLAN/TASKS plans are detected by SPEC.md presence and run on the unchanged legacy path — zero regression. The detection seam at commands/z-implement-all.md:413 is the ONLY branch; do not add a second detection elsewhere.
INV-5: No new env vars. All new knobs (planning_mode, intent_level, intent_parallel_levels, hermes_enabled) are file-resolvable via config.py get workflow.<key> from .z-harness/config.toml.
INV-6: Old Hermes machinery (workstream gen, N=2 cross-cluster dispatch, write-handoff, scope-extractor) never executes unless workflow.hermes_enabled=true (default false).
gotchas: MODE DETECTION IS BINARY: SPEC.md presence = legacy (forever). Adding INTENT.md to a slug that already has SPEC.md does NOT switch it to INTENT mode. The legacy path wins.
frozen_at: 'pending' is a signal, not an error. /z-implement-all reads 'pending' as 'not yet frozen' and stamps the ISO on first execution. Do not delete the field.

stale_reason: amended-intent in TASKS.md frontmatter signals the task-tree-generator to regenerate rather than resume on the next /z-implement-all. Set by /z-amend Phase 6; consumed by the BFS loop generator dispatch.
evaluate-acceptance is called at EVERY level checkpoint, not just the last. It may return 'done' at Level 0 if the first level's tasks fully satisfy all criteria — the loop exits early.
intent_parallel_levels=false (default): independent same-level siblings run sequentially. Enabling it (true) requires workflow.hermes_enabled=true to have any effect — the two knobs are coupled.

The level state file ($ARCHIVE_DIR/.intent_level_state) stores '<level> <done_set_hash>'. Hash mismatch on resume (TASKS.md changed since checkpoint) forces restart from level 0 — a safety fallback, not an error.
LEDGER_DECISIONS entries from the implementer must cite the criterion they advance (e.g. 'advances criterion #2'). The evaluator cross-references LEDGER citations when scoring acceptance.

/z-do and /z-plan-light are now deprecated shims: both print a notice and immediately hand off to /z-plan --quick or --standard. Their old bodies are still present but never execute on new invocations.

knobs.description: Default planner paradigm. 'full' = legacy SDD (SPEC/PLAN/TASKS). 'intent' = Adaptive INTENT (default).
Forced planning depth level, or 'auto' to let the intent-classifier choose.
Execute independent same-level tasks in parallel. Gated-off by default. Requires hermes_enabled=true to have effect.
Master gate for all old Hermes parallelism machinery. Default false = all workstream/handoff/cross-plan calls are no-ops.
